targets.expr: (sum by (instance, proxy_engine) (label_replace(rate(caddy_http_requests_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$interval]), "proxy_engine", "caddy", "", "")) or sum by (instance, proxy_engine) (label_replace(rate(haproxy_frontend_http_requests_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$interval]), "proxy_engine", "haproxy", "", "")) or sum by (instance, proxy_engine) (label_replace(rate(fluxgate_http_requests_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$interval]), "proxy_engine", "fluxgate", "", "")))

(sum by (instance, proxy_engine) (label_replace(caddy_http_requests_in_flight{instance=~"$instance"}, "proxy_engine", "caddy", "", "")) or max by (instance, proxy_engine) (label_replace(haproxy_process_current_connections{instance=~"$instance"}, "proxy_engine", "haproxy", "", "")) or max by (instance, proxy_engine) (label_replace(fluxgate_active_connections{instance=~"$instance"}, "proxy_engine", "fluxgate", "", "")))

(max by (instance, proxy_engine) (label_replace(process_resident_memory_bytes{job=~"caddy|xhttp-caddy",instance=~"$instance"}, "proxy_engine", "caddy", "", "")) or max by (instance, proxy_engine) (label_replace(fluxgate_process_resident_memory_bytes{instance=~"$instance"}, "proxy_engine", "fluxgate", "", "")) or max by (instance, proxy_engine) (label_replace(namedprocess_namegroup_memory_bytes{groupname=~"caddy|haproxy|fluxgate",memtype="resident",instance=~"$instance"} > 0, "proxy_engine", "$1", "groupname", "(.*)")))

(sum by (instance, proxy_engine) (label_replace(rate(process_cpu_seconds_total{job=~"caddy|xhttp-caddy",instance=~"$instance"}[$interval]), "proxy_engine", "caddy", "", "")) or sum by (instance, proxy_engine) (label_replace(rate(namedprocess_namegroup_cpu_seconds_total{groupname=~"caddy|haproxy|fluxgate",instance=~"$instance"}[$interval]), "proxy_engine", "$1", "groupname", "(.*)")))

(label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, instance) (rate(caddy_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{instance=~"$instance"}[$interval]))), "proxy_engine", "caddy", "", "") or label_replace(max by (instance) (haproxy_backend_response_time_average_seconds{proxy="be_xray_xhttp",instance=~"$instance"}) * 0.2, "proxy_engine", "haproxy", "", "") or label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, instance) (rate(fluxgate_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{instance=~"$instance"}[$interval]))), "proxy_engine", "fluxgate", "", ""))

(label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance) (rate(caddy_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{instance=~"$instance"}[$interval]))), "proxy_engine", "caddy", "", "") or label_replace(max by (instance) (haproxy_backend_response_time_average_seconds{proxy="be_xray_xhttp",instance=~"$instance"}) * 0.5, "proxy_engine", "haproxy", "", "") or label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance) (rate(fluxgate_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{instance=~"$instance"}[$interval]))), "proxy_engine", "fluxgate", "", ""))

(label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, instance) (rate(caddy_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{instance=~"$instance"}[$interval]))), "proxy_engine", "caddy", "", "") or label_replace(max by (instance) (haproxy_backend_response_time_average_seconds{proxy="be_xray_xhttp",instance=~"$instance"}), "proxy_engine", "haproxy", "", "") or label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, instance) (rate(fluxgate_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{instance=~"$instance"}[$interval]))), "proxy_engine", "fluxgate", "", ""))

(label_replace((sum by (instance) (rate(caddy_http_requests_total{code=~"5..",instance=~"$instance"}[$interval])) or (sum by (instance) (rate(caddy_http_requests_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$interval])) * 0)) / clamp_min(sum by (instance) (rate(caddy_http_requests_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$interval])), 0.0001), "proxy_engine", "caddy", "", "") or label_replace(sum by (instance) (rate(haproxy_frontend_request_errors_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance) (rate(haproxy_frontend_http_requests_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$interval])), 0.0001), "proxy_engine", "haproxy", "", "") or label_replace(sum by (instance) (rate(fluxgate_http_requests_total{status=~"5..",instance=~"$instance"}[$interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance) (rate(fluxgate_http_requests_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$interval])), 0.0001), "proxy_engine", "fluxgate", "", ""))
